With 207 rooms, 7 meeting venues, and buzzing spots like De Japanner Zuid and the Manhattan Lounge-Bar, we offer guests and team members a place to connect, grow, and belong — as part of the global IHG Hotels & Resorts family.Your day to day:
• Greeting and assisting guests upon arrival, ensuring a smooth and friendly check-in experience
• Maintaining a high level of guest satisfaction through clear communication before, during, and after each stay
• Supporting the Front Office team in handling reservations, inquiries, and guest requests
• Assisting with VIP arrivals and ensuring all guest preferences are communicated to the right departments
• Following Crowne Plaza and IHG brand standards to ensure consistent, high-quality service
• Helping with administrative tasks and learning operational procedures such as checklists, reports, and shift handovers
• Working in various shifts — morning, afternoon, or evening — alongside our passionate team
• Contributing your own ideas to improve guest experiences and internal processes

Ready to land this internship?

Meat Packaging Production Worker 
 Back to overview 
 Alkmaar Vomar 
Vomar Voordeelmarkt is a Dutch family-owned supermarket chain that has been in business since 1968. The company has more than 60 stores in the Netherlands and serves hundreds of thousands of customers every week. Job Description 
Meat Packaging Production Worker. You will work in the meat department and be responsible for packaging and processing meat products. Depending on your role, you will also operate production machinery. 
Scope of Work: - Packaging of Meat Products - Working with Meat - Operating production machines, depending on the position - Checking the quality of products - Ensuring that the products are properly prepared 
Job Requirements: - Communicative proficiency in English - Experience with meat or machinery in the meat industry - Willingness to work with meat - Willingness to work in a cool environment - The position is open to both women and men 
Working hours: - Work Monday through Saturday - Occasionally, work is also done on Sundays 
Work Environment and Transportation: - Working in the meat department - Cool work environment - Location: Alkmaar 
Salary: 
€14.99 gross per hour, paid weekly. Transportation and Housing - Free shipping to the Netherlands - Comfortable accommodations in double rooms close to work 
Do you have experience with meat or machinery and would you like to work in the meat department at Vomar? Then this job opening at Alkmaar is for you!

A diverse and dynamic environment 
As a reach truck driver at Vos Logistics, you are responsible for the safe and efficient movement of goods. You work according to established procedures, safety regulations, and quality standards, ensuring that goods are correctly stored or prepared for shipment. 
You skillfully operate the reach truck and perform checking activities to ensure that goods and stocks match the registration. In addition, you are familiar with warehouse processes, inventory management, and applicable work instructions. 
Daily, you work with automated WMS systems and ensure accurate processing by correctly scanning and registering barcodes, pallets, and quantities. You coordinate your activities with colleagues in the warehouse and maintain contact with the warehouse coordinator about progress and specifics. 
With your accuracy, sense of responsibility, and craftsmanship, you contribute to a safe and smooth logistics process at Vos Logistics. 
 We have your job! Do you have the skills?

English is a plus.
